authorization: Explicit user instruction to add AH opening-consistency / company-divergence audit into MODEL_1 during the formal freeze; 0.75/0.5/0.25 were examples only and the rule applies to every valid Asian handicap line.
purpose: Detect genuine same-information-regime AH disagreement across the full handicap ladder without letting isolated non-mainstream books distort the core market consensus.

line_normalization.general_split_rule: Any valid x/y quarter split is represented by its arithmetic midpoint only for line-distance/QC comparison; settlement remains on the original split handicap.

core_consensus.when_core_is_split_across_adjacent_lines: Preserve the observed band rather than inventing an unquoted synthetic main line.

price_and_ladder_qc.if_ladder_missing: Keep price compensation as uncertainty; do not manufacture an equivalent line.

deviation_measurement.formula: normalized_company_home_handicap minus nearest boundary of the core consensus band

grades.D0: No material divergence: inside core band, or at most one quarter-goal step with plausible price/ladder explanation, or QC prevents a genuine disagreement claim.
grades.D1: Mild/isolated divergence: typically one company or one slice, or a one-to-two quarter-step gap that quickly converges or remains materially explained by price/ladder context.
grades.D2: Material genuine divergence: verified MAIN line, same-time/same-regime gap of at least two quarter-goal steps (0.5 goal) from the core band, not explained by price/ladder, persistent across at least two comparable slices or through a core reprice. Applies identically whether the core line is PK, -0.25, -0.75, -1.5, -2.25, +0.5 or any other valid AH line.
grades.D3: Cluster split: at least two independent verified secondary companies each show persistent D2-level divergence from the core cluster, or a verified secondary cluster reprices materially opposite to the core across multiple comparable slices. Operator independence must be known or D3 is not allowed.

formal_interpretation.persistent_shallow_vs_selected_side: Material counterevidence to the selected side's AH cover strength; must be explained against 1X2, OU, attraction and lifecycle.
formal_interpretation.persistent_deep_vs_selected_side: Material support for the selected side's AH cover strength only after attraction and price compensation are audited.

anti_error_examples.not_genuine_divergence: A secondary quote is hours earlier, belongs to another information regime, is ALT/display rather than MAIN, or is sufficiently compensated by price/ladder structure.
anti_error_examples.genuine_candidate: At any AH level, a verified secondary MAIN line stays at least 0.5 goal away from the same-time core consensus band without sufficient price/ladder explanation across multiple comparable slices.
anti_error_examples.cluster_split_candidate: At any AH level, two independent verified secondary books remain materially separated from the core while the core reprices and the secondary cluster refuses to follow or moves the other way.
